prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a premium high-fidelity design comparison board for ClaudeBar, a native macOS floating AI-session utility on an external monitor with NO notch. Landscape image, crisp readable interface text, straight-on actual software UI, no device render, browser chrome or marketing illustration. Show THREE states of ONE coherent concept side-by-side on a quiet pale slate desktop background, each generously separated. Small board labels: "A · Focus deck", then "收起", "选中会话", "待确认"; label fixture data "示例数据".
Pinned visual world: thin silver-white ceramic shell, deeply inset dark indigo information surface, warm orange reserved for an actionable waiting state. Precise system sans typography, expertly aligned baselines, physical depth only from subtle bevel and directional shadow. Distinctive yet implementable with native 2D shapes; restrained, expensive instrument feel.
Concept A is a focus deck: a compact slim status bar contains three discrete agent marks, a short current-task readout and a small waiting indicator. Expanded state preserves that EXACT top bar as an attached header; beneath it an indigo stage gives one selected task generous typographic hierarchy. Show "ClaudeBar", "Codex", "exec · build.sh", "运行中", and the explicit action "回到会话 ↗". Other tasks are quiet small tabs, not equal cards or a generic vertical list. Bottom silver lip holds "今日 2313.3万 Token" and "$10.54 + ¥3.78". The waiting state preserves geometry but places "需要你确认" and "Bash · 执行构建命令" in focus, with a warm orange "去确认 ↗" control. No invented progress percentage, chat input, approve/deny button, waves, constant glow, decorative 3D object or full dashboard.
revision_prompt: Edit this ClaudeBar UI concept board. Preserve the silver-white perimeter, indigo display, three-column presentation and excellent typography. Make concept A genuinely compact: remove ALL the three task cards, environment section, command details section and explanation section from the two expanded states. Expanded panels must be only about twice the height of the collapsed bar. Preserve the top strip, then show ONE beautifully spaced focus row with project title 'ClaudeBar', secondary activity 'exec · build.sh', and a small neutral-blue '回到会话 ↗' button. Footer stays. In the waiting panel, the selected agent MUST be Claude (not Codex), focus text '需要你确认', secondary 'Bash · 执行构建命令', orange '去确认 ↗'. No Sonnet task, no invented file path, no fake extra metadata. The result must feel like a small precise floating instrument, never a dashboard. Keep the board title 'A · Focus deck' and state labels.
note: Visual concept only. Fixture data. Production must preserve native marks and real session capabilities; orange belongs only to waiting actions, not the running button shown in C.
approval: 用户：A吧，凸显设计感，精心打磨细节
